description: Defines a Java class ReadableOrderProductDownload representing downloadable order product information, including details such as order ID, product name, download URL, file name, expiry days, and download count.

classes.name: ReadableOrderProductDownload
classes.description: A Java class representing downloadable product details within an order, extending Entity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: getDownloadExpiryDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days until the download expires.

methods.name: setDownloadExpiryDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days until the download expires.

methods.name: getDownloadCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the download has been accessed.

methods.name: setDownloadCount
methods.description: Sets the number of times the download has been accessed.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getDownloadUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for downloading the product.

methods.name: setDownloadUrl
methods.description: Sets the download URL for the product.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the order associated with this download.

methods.name: setOrderId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the order associated with this download.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the file name associated with the download.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the file name associated with the download.
